repository.base_branch_note: Local branch main. No remote is configured.
repository.import_method: Built in this workspace as a git repository (5 commits from an initial skeleton). Not imported from a ZIP or GitHub.
repository.framework: None. Python standard library http.server, sqlite3 and csv, with plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript in the browser.
repository.routes: Single page at / with a JSON API under /api: items (list/create/get/update/delete), alerts, export.csv, import.

requirements.text: Register, edit, search (name, category, location), filter by category, delete with confirmation.
requirements.original: Not present in the skeleton (README only).
requirements.result: Implemented in the API, database layer and single-page UI.
requirements.evidence: test_crud_lifecycle; test_search_and_alerts_and_banner_count; browser: register, edit, search/filter, delete

requirements.text: Name, category, quantity, location, last updated (automatic, UTC) and a per-item alert threshold.
requirements.result: Implemented with validation that reports every bad field.

requirements.text: Alert when quantity is below the threshold (default 5): banner, LOW badge, low-only filter, GET /api/alerts.
requirements.result: Implemented. The comparison is strictly below the threshold.
requirements.evidence: test_threshold_is_strictly_below; test_alert_clears_when_restocked; browser: low-stock alert, edit clears alert

requirements.text: Export to CSV and import with upsert by name and location; bad rows are skipped and reported with line numbers.
requirements.result: Implemented, including UTF-8 BOM handling and a guard against spreadsheet formula injection on export.
requirements.evidence: test_round_trip; test_import_upserts_and_reports_bad_rows_with_line_numbers; test_export_neutralises_formula_injection; browser: import with row error report, CSV export

requirements.text: Persistent storage that survives a restart.
requirements.result: SQLite file storage. Data survives a server restart and a page reload.
requirements.evidence: test_data_survives_server_restart; browser: data persists across reload

requirements.text: Local use safe by default: parameterised SQL, no HTML injection, bounded request bodies, no traceback leakage.
requirements.result: Implemented. Binds to 127.0.0.1, 2 MB body limit returns 413, CSP default-src self, nosniff.
requirements.evidence: test_sql_injection_is_inert; test_oversized_body_rejected; test_security_headers_and_html_served; browser: HTML in names is not executed

tools.name: Python 3.12 standard library
tools.reason: Zero dependencies and runs on any PC with Python; http.server, sqlite3, csv and unittest cover the whole backend and tests.

tools.name: SQLite (sqlite3)
tools.reason: One-file database that is easy to back up. Adequate for a small team on one machine.

tools.name: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript
tools.reason: No build step, no Node dependency; the UI is small enough that a framework adds nothing.

tools.name: Playwright with Chromium/Edge
tools.reason: Drives the real UI for end-to-end tests and screenshots. It is not a runtime dependency of the app.

tools.name: Flask / FastAPI with SQLAlchemy
tools.reason: Would add routing and an ORM convenience, but the project's own note says neither is needed at this size; the db.py / server.py layering keeps a later swap straightforward.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.reason: Suits many concurrent users; the app serialises writes with a lock and targets a small team.

tools.name: GitHub CLI, Docker, pytest
tools.reason: Not installed in the build environment (per docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). Tests use unittest instead of pytest.

limitations: No login. The server binds to 127.0.0.1; put it behind an authenticating reverse proxy before exposing it to a network.
http.server is fine for a small team on one machine. Writes are serialised with a lock, so it is not built for heavy concurrency.
No audit history of changes, no roles, no barcode scanning, no multi-user conflict handling beyond the write lock.
